name: Route
description: Our merchants long to reach your capital! Build a road to connect your capital to our city and watch trade flourish between our peoples.

name: Clear Barbarian Camp
description: Barbarians have made camp dangerously close to our city and terrorize our people! We beg you — send your armies to destroy them before it is too late.

name: Connect Resource
description: Our economy desperately needs [tileResource]! Connect it to your trade network and our peoples will both grow stronger from the exchange.

name: Construct Wonder
description: Show the world the glory of your civilization! We challenge you to raise [wonder] — a monument that will echo across the ages.

name: Acquire Great Person
description: The light of genius changes history! Attract a [greatPerson] to your civilization and earn our deepest admiration and gratitude.

name: Find Player
description: Our scouts report that [civName] has founded cities, yet their lands remain a mystery to us. Discover their territory and bring us knowledge of their whereabouts.

name: Find Natural Wonder
description: Legends speak of [naturalWonder], a breathtaking marvel hidden somewhere in the world. Send your greatest explorers to find it and claim the glory of discovery!

name: Give Gold
description: We are suffering great poverty after being robbed by [civName]. Without aid, our city faces collapse. A generous Gold donation will restore hope to our desperate people!

name: Pledge to Protect
description: The armies of [civName] loom at our borders and we fear annihilation. Only a Pledge of Protection from a powerful friend can deter them — will you stand by our side?

name: Contest Culture
description: The great civilizations of the world compete for cultural supremacy! The civilization that accumulates the most Culture growth during this contest shall be handsomely rewarded.

name: Contest Faith
description: The divine calls to all peoples of the earth! Whichever civilization generates the greatest Faith during this sacred period shall receive our highest blessings.

name: Contest Technologies
description: The age of discovery is upon us! The civilization that researches the greatest number of Technologies during this period shall be recognized as the vanguard of progress.

name: Invest
description: A great tourism boom has come to our city! For a limited time, every Gold donation you make will yield [70]% extra Influence. Invest now while the opportunity lasts!

name: Spread Religion
description: Pilgrims from our city have heard of [religionName] and their hearts burn with curiosity. Send missionaries to enlighten our people and forge an eternal spiritual bond between our civilizations.
